section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study conducted in Iran involving university students from seven large universities in Tehran. Participants completed a paper-and-pencil survey that included the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2), which was translated into Persian following a rigorous translation and back-translation protocol. Data collection occurred between December 2014 and June 2015, with participants completing questionnaires anonymously in classroom settings on a voluntary basis.
